title: ID0366430-DC/Si-D/FI-[Gz0OS6] - Charger SCB offline
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Charger is in a FailSafeMode and SCB connection is offline.
Root cause: Router 1 offline
Solution: Replace Ethernet cable

additional_info.subject: ID0366430-DC/Si-D/FI-[Gz0OS6] - Charger SCB offline & Dispenser_PLC_A_KF201 CRM:00315001552
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus,
After yesterday's site visit, the Router was turned on but the Ethernet connection was not present. As such we were not able to reach the router.
After you power cycle the router, it was working again.
From what I shared, you replaced the router some 6 months ago, so  I don't believe the problem to be the router itself.
We replaced the Ethernet cable for the Router and we will monitor the behaviour from now on.
We also noticed that the APN was not correct which is impossible since we didn't perform any tasks on the router prior to being offline.
Regarding the Dispenser PLC error → after a reboot we find this error → PLC not in operating state run, state=7
What we found is the following:
If you shutdown the main unit from the display, dispenser plc is blinking and remains partially on. When bootin up main unit, dispenser plc is still blinking and stuck. But if you reboot, dispenser plc is coming back or if you power cycle the dispenser plc is also works again.
I will try to understand what this State=7 means  since there is no information regarding this value and will come back to you.
I will change the title to include the dispenser error too.
Thank you for your patience.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0366430-DC/Si-D/FI-[Gz0OS6] - Charger SCB offline & Dispenser_PLC_A_KF201 CRM:00315001552
additional_info.body:
Hello Markus, good morning. I hope you are doing well :)
For the SCB offline, did the charger go offline since we replaced the Ethernet cable?
For the Dispenser Error Flag:
I found this in the R&D wiki but it's not been updated for almost 2 years, but according to a new page:
Which looks exactly the same.
In this case, it means that the Dispenser is waiting for the Selftest.
I will test some scenarios here in the Training Center and will come back to you when I have an answer. Just give me one information, does this error only occur if you turn off the charger via HMI?
Because if I'm wondering if FC2 or FC3 really powers down and the dispenser is still powered on and just can't recover after an error since the main charger is expecting it powered off.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
